Computer Science & Engineering
DEPARTMENT
Welcome Note by the Department - HOD
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is a Hub of innovation, research, and academic excellence. Recognized as a centre for advancing technology across all domains, the department provides students with abundant opportunities to excel academically and personally.
With a strong focus on Hands-on Learning, Industry Collaboration, and Cutting-edge research, our students consistently publish in reputed journals and gain valuable exposure through real-world experiences.
The Department of CSE has been proudly collaborating with CISCO since 2016 which is a centre of excellence, providing students with valuable opportunities for Internships, Training, and Placements through the CISCO Networking Academy initiative. Additionally, the department has collaborations with Viksha and APSSDC to conduct various Workshops, Hackathons, and Skill Development programs that enhance students’ practical knowledge and industry readiness. Active ACM, IEEE, and CSI student branches organize diverse technical and non-technical events, fostering leadership, teamwork, and confidence.
Our department continually strives to nurture creativity, critical thinking, and technical competence among students while fostering a spirit of lifelong learning.
Through various initiatives such as Research projects, Hackathons, industrial visits, and Technical symposiums, we provide a vibrant platform for students to explore emerging technologies and showcase their talents. The dedicated efforts of our faculty and students in academics, research, and extracurricular activities reflect the department’s commitment to holistic development and excellence. The department’s mission is to instil innovation, scientific curiosity, and professional excellence, preparing students to thrive in the ever-evolving world of technology.
We take pride in shaping future-ready professionals who will lead the next wave of technological advancements and contribute meaningfully to society. Regular interaction with software companies has helped the department in maintaining its syllabus abreast with technology and industrial standards. The rigorous learning environment has helped make students job-ready.
HOD-CSE
VISION & MISSION
Vision of the Department
To produce globally competent, dynamic and multi-talented young leaders with skill & knowledge in Computer Science and Engineering to cater the contemporary demands of the software industry, thereby making them industry ready while at the institution and also to pursue higher education imbibing holistic approach.
Mission of the Department
To impart high quality technical education in Computer Science and Engineering by providing core values and well equipped infrastructure.
To provide advanced research and technical consultancy services with qualified and senior faculty.
To prepare the learners professionally deft and intellectually adept possessing excellent skill, knowledge and behavior.
To inculcate the leadership capabilities in learners to face the dynamic and challenging global work of the Computer Science and Engineering field.
PROGRAM EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES
PEO 1 -
To impart foundations of applied science and engineering subjects in order to apply, analyze and solve problems in computational aspects.
PEO 2 -
To inculcate ability in creativity and design of computer support systems and impart knowledge and skills to analyze, design, test and implement various software applications.
PEO 3 -
To strengthen higher education, research, prepare for globally acclaimed competitions, imbibe in civic-leadership qualities and to trigger social, ethical, holistic and behavioral approach.
PROGRAM SPECIFIC OUTCOMES
After the program students are able to:
PSO 1: -
Problem Solving Skills: Ability to design and develop computing tools with moderate complexity in the areas pertaining to database, data analytics, networking, web and app design, IoT and information security with integration.
PSO 2 -
Professional Skills: Ability to apply standard practices and methods in software project management and software development using suitable programming environments to deliver quality products to the industry.
PROGRAM OUTCOMES
ENGINEERING KNOWLEDGE:-
Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
PROBLEM ANALYSIS: -
Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
DESIGN/DEVELOPMENT OF SOLUTIONS: -
Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
CONDUCT INVESTIGATIONS OF COMPLEX PROBLEMS: -
Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
MODERN TOOL USAGE: -
Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
THE ENGINEER AND SOCIETY: -
Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABILITY: -
Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
ETHICS: -
Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
INDIVIDUAL AND TEAM WORK: -
Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
COMMUNICATION: -
Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND FINANCE: -
Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
LIFE-LONG LEARNING: -
Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.
CAREER OPPORTUNITIES
In an era that is powered and driven by Internet of Technology (IOT) devices and Artificial intelligence (AI), computer science engineers are required in every nook and corner of the world from small scale industries to sophisticated workstations. From games developer to manager of Information Technology and communications services, a computer science graduate can find opportunities in the software sector, consultancies, and major corporations, where they offer digital solutions to contemporary issues.
The graduates can opt for immediate employment through placements or higher education through advanced courses such as M.Tech or Masters of Science (MS) across India or abroad for various advanced computing courses.

PLACEMENT STORIES
It gives me great pleasure to say with pride that I have completed my B.Tech (Computer Science Engineering) from SV College Of Engineering ( SVCE). There are plenty of placement opportunities in SVCE. Fact is that teachers are very kind to the students. They make sure every class is educational, interacting and filled with fun. Different technical and cultural events have boosted my confidence. I am glad to be a part of the SVCE Family.
K. Sai Dinesh-CSE-2017
Placement in Accenture as Associate Software Engineer
SVCE college is one of my best turning point to my future. I learned a lot of things from my college. It was given to a lot of best friends. The community took my skills to another level, the faculty was given great opportunities for developing internal and external strength, the placement cell which is also doing a great job by arranging excellent placements of MNCs. I not only learned computer science subjects, with the help of IEDC I learned other branch subjects. Thanks to SVCE. I am glad to be part of it.
Kethan Vemuri–CSE-2020
Placement in TCS as Associate Software Engineer
Graduating from SVCE in Computer Science & Engineering has been a launchpad into a world of possibility. At SVCE, classrooms weren’t just spaces for lectures they were hubs of curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. The faculty guided us with wisdom and warmth, blending structure with encouragement. Through vibrant technical fests and colorful cultural carnivals, I grew into a confident and expressive leader. One of the most transformative milestones was being part of Stanford University’s University Innovation Fellows (UIF) program, a journey that took my ideas to a global stage and connected me with changemakers around the world. SVCE didn’t just teach me engineering, it cultivated innovation, cultural intelligence, and the courage to dream boldly. I’m proud to be an SVCE student, forever rooted in this inspiring legacy.
Theertham Rajasri–CSE-2021
Placement at IIT Tirupati Navavishkar I-Hub Foundation (IITTNiF)
My experience at SVCE, Tirupati was truly memorable. The college offers good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and a vibrant campus life. College also provides great opportunities for personal growth through various clubs and activities. I appreciate the balanced environment where academics and extracurriculars go hand in hand. I am grateful for the valuable learning and cherished memories from my time at SVCE.
Akhilesh Sobilla CSE 2019-23
